company.shortDescription: Credibook is a startup helping retail wholesalers to keep track of receivables and payables.
company.description: Credibook is a startup helping retail wholesalers to keep track of receivables and payables. The startup digitizes the supply chain between wholesale and retail for more efficient inventory sourcing. It provides a variety of products and services that enable business owners to manage their businesses using digital technology, from order management to financial records. They intend to expand throughout Indonesia and reach out to more business sectors.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $8,100,000, or 80.2% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $7,463,963 to $38,633,608, a 5.18x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 59 (+1 over 90 days) and market heat at 50 (+2).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
